class.name: LibraryCraft
class.brief_description: Resource creation tool (CraftTable) for the Zyris Library.
class.description: [LibraryCraft] provides an interface to instantiate new resources based on domains registered with the [ResourceServer]. It uses creation wizards and save dialogs to simplify gameplay data generation.

method.name: create_resource_by_class
method.description: Instantiates a new [Resource] based on the provided class name.

method.name: create_resource_from_domain
method.description: Instantiates a new [Resource] based on a domain registered in the [ResourceServer].
